wywf.config.title: What You Want To Find
wywf.config.general.language.name: Language
wywf.config.general.language.desc:
Which synonym language the query parser uses.
EN: English only (default)
RU: Russian only
AUTO: merge EN + RU (all synonyms)
wywf.config.general.performance.name: Performance
wywf.config.general.performance.desc:
How many CPU cores the search may use.
AUTO: ~65% (ECONOMY if CPU <= 4 threads)
ECONOMY: ~25% — quiet mode
HIGH: ~75% — fast search
MAX: all cores — maximum speed
wywf.config.search.scan.name: Scan area
wywf.config.search.scan.structure_radius:
How far from the search center to look for
structures (villages, temples, strongholds, etc.).

1 chunk = 16 blocks = small terrain area.
Recommended: 40-64 chunks.
Larger = slower, but more likely to find.
Default: 40 (640 blocks from center).
wywf.config.search.scan.biome_radius.des:
How far from the search center to check biomes
(forest, desert, ocean, etc.).

1 chunk = 16 blocks = small terrain area.
Recommended: 16-32 chunks.
Increase if the biome is far away.
Default: 16 (256 blocks from center).
wywf.config.search.scan.biome_step.desc:
How often to sample biomes. Lower = more accurate, slower.

1 = check every block (most accurate, slowest)
4 = check every 4th block (default)
8 = check every 8th block (fast, rough)

Default: 4.
wywf.config.search.center.name: Search center
wywf.config.search.center.desc:
Where to start searching for structures and biomes.

ORIGIN (0, 0): from world center (default).
SPAWN: from player world spawn.
BOTH: checks both origin and spawn.

ORIGIN — faster and more accurate.
SPAWN — finds near your spawn point.
BOTH — combines both options.
wywf.config.search.limits.name: Limits
wywf.config.search.limits.desc: Search stops when either limit is reached.
wywf.config.search.limits.time.desc:
Maximum search time.
When time runs out, search stops and shows
found results.

Minimum: 5 minutes. Default: 30 minutes.
wywf.config.search.limits.infinite.desc:
When ON, seed limit is ignored — search runs
until time limit or candidates found.

Max seeds setting is disabled.
Default: OFF.
wywf.config.search.limits.max_seeds.desc:
Maximum number of seeds to evaluate.
Search stops when reached.
Disabled when 'Infinite seeds' is ON.

1M = 1,000,000
10M = 10,000,000 (default)
1B = 1,000,000,000

Range: 1M — 1B. Default: 10M.
wywf.config.search.candidates.name: Candidates
wywf.config.search.candidates.collect.de:
How many matching seeds to find before stopping.

More = more options to choose from.
Fewer = finishes faster.

Default: 8.
wywf.config.search.candidates.stop_first:
When ON, stops at the first match for
fastest results, but no choice.

Default: OFF (collects multiple candidates).
wywf.config.search.candidates.sort_dista:
When ON, the final candidate is chosen by distance
to the nearest structure (closest first), rather
than randomly.

Default: OFF.
